login.title: Sign in to your DNS server
login.subtitle: Authenticate with a console account or an API token
login.heroTitle: A DNS console built for operators
login.heroBody: Zones, records, DNSSEC, cache, filtering, logs, DHCP and clustering — in one modern interface that switches between servers.
login.heroPoint1: Tokens stay in an httpOnly cookie and travel via the proxy
login.heroPoint2: Move between several DNS servers without re-authenticating
login.serverHelp: Leave blank to use the default server configured on this host.
login.rememberLabel: Keep me signed in on this browser
login.rememberHelp: Credentials are stored in an httpOnly cookie — never in the URL bar or browser history.
login.tokenHelp: Best for automation. The token lands in an httpOnly cookie that JavaScript cannot read.
login.needHelp: Trouble signing in? Make sure the web console is enabled on the DNS server.
login.defaultCredentialsWarning: This server is still using the default credentials. Change the administrator password as soon as possible.
login.tokenTooShort: An API token is at least 16 characters.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.invalid: That code is invalid or has expired. Try again.
twoFactor.lostDevice: Lost your device? Ask an administrator to reset two-factor authentication.
twoFactor.enableSubtitle: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or any TOTP app
twoFactor.step1: Scan the QR code, or enter the secret key manually
twoFactor.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app
twoFactor.enabledHint: Sign-in now requires a verification code. Keep a recovery path in mind.
twoFactor.disableHint: Disabling weakens your account. Enter a current code to confirm.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.subtitle: Other sessions stay valid until their tokens expire.
changePassword.totpHelp: Required when two-factor authentication is enabled.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
changePassword.tooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters
changePassword.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one
changePassword.ssoUserHint: Accounts created through single sign-on have their password managed by the identity provider.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
session.invalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
session.mySessionsHint: Every active token and session for this account.
session.revokeConfirm: Revoke this session? Devices using that token lose access immediately.

apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.subtitle: Long-lived tokens for scripts and automation, with no interactive sign-in.
apiTokens.nameHelp: Used to recognise the token in the session list.
apiTokens.createdWarning: The full token is shown only once. Copy and store it now.
apiTokens.noTokensHint: Tokens you create show up in the “My sessions” list.
apiTokens.revokeHint: Tokens can be revoked at any time from “My sessions”.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your display name appears in audit entries and the session list.
profile.permissionsHint: Granted by an administrator on the Permissions page.
profile.noPermissions: This account has not been granted any permissions.

permission.title: Insufficient permissions
permission.body: Your account cannot access this page.
permission.hint: Ask an administrator to grant access for your user or group under Administration → Permissions.

connectionFailed.title: Cannot reach the DNS server
connectionFailed.body: The console could not establish a session with the selected server.
